positions.name: ZypherionAdoptionPerformed
positions.frame: how is the Zypherion database decision performed — declared, justified, and committed to a timeline?
positions.why: All three are Quinton Fairweather's own utterances enacting one decision arc: a declarative that ratifies the choice as already settled ('We are adopting Zypherion'), an assertive that marshals quantified evidence to justify it ('15x faster'), and a commissive that binds the org to a schedule ('starts next quarter'). The relational/power reads mark src-1 and src-3 as authority-ranking/legitimate acts of decision, while src-2 sits closer to rational-persuasion/claim rather than ratification — a live tension the group holds rather than resolves: the decision is announced and scheduled with more conviction than the performance claim that justifies it is defended.
